title: Cookie King By Drip More 100ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Just like their crowd pleasing Candy King shortfills, these 100ml Drip More Cookie King shortfills bring their sure to please flavours based on cookie recipes that will light your taste buds on fire with delight. You and your buds will relish the flavours of this range with Drip More’s high quality, industry leading name that delivers both great flavours and great vaping experiences.
Being e-liquids with a high VG ratio, these Drip More Cookie King shortfills are perfect for Sub-Ohm vaping devices and kits to use. With any of these, you will be able to best experience with the flavour of your choice thick, flavourful vapour clouds with less hits to the throat for an overall smooth experience. For ex-smokers looking to get their nicotine cravings fulfilled, there is enough room for up to 2 nicotine shots which emulates that feeling found when smoking tobacco cigarettes.
– Made In The USA
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 10ml Nicotine shots
– 70VG/30PG
– Ideal for Sub-Ohm Devices & Kits
– Childproof Cap & Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Compliant
Flavors
Choco Cream
A deliciously fresh baked gooey chocolate cookie blend that has been fused with a silky smooth vanilla cream filling.
DVNK
A delicious blend of graham cracker flavour that has been dipped in a smooth vanilla cream for a classic and enjoyable all day vape.
Lemon Wafer
A freshly baked Vanilla cookie that has been stuffed with a delicious citrusy lemon cream for a tangy dessert vape.
